nodes.label: Cloudflared Tunnel Configuration
nodes.rationale: Used to expose the local app via Cloudflare tunnel, isolating it from localhost access for security.

nodes.label: Neumorphism Styling
nodes.rationale: Adopted for a premium soft UI look using dark slate background and inset/outshadow effects instead of pure black, providing a 3D effect to buttons and cards.

nodes.label: Workout Tracker Application
nodes.rationale: A workout tracking application with a neumorphic UI, isolated via Cloudflare tunnel, and installable as a PWA on iOS.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon
nodes.rationale: Added to index.html and PWA manifest to ensure the app has a specific custom logo when added to the iOS Home Screen.

nodes.label: Gym Hamster Banner
nodes.rationale: Used as the main mascot banner on the dashboard. Decided to keep it uncropped and without borders to maintain character integrity.
